title: 5 cool Galaxy Watch features I love to show off
summary: Cool Galaxy Watch tricks worth showing off.
content: A watch has always been more than just a timekeeping accessory. It's also a style statement, and many conceive of it as a status symbol. But with smartwatches becoming increasingly common, simply wearing one doesn't make you stand out anymore. That's where I like to get a little creative with my Galaxy Watch Ultra.

title: I tried the top 3 Arch-based Linux distros to replace Windows 11, and only one is a worthy daily driver
summary: Arch-based distros are more popular than ever, but are they ready to replace your Windows 11 PC?
content: For the longest time, Arch Linux has had a reputation for being hard, technically demanding, and best left to Linux veterans. However, thanks to an army of Arch-made-simple distros , the once-dreaded distro is now more accessible than ever before. But are they really simple enough for Linux newcomers and complete beginners?

title: Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 is $100 off on Amazon
summary: Get the Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 for $100 off on Amazon. Up to 3,000 nits of brightness, plus ECG, blood oxygen, and body composition sensors.
content: Most people want a smartwatch that tracks workouts and health stats without much fuss, and the sensors separate the capable models from the basic ones. The Samsung Galaxy Watch 8 40mm tracks optical heart rate, ECG, blood oxygen, body composition, and more. It's now on sale on Amazon as part of a Black Friday deal.
